question: A gun is fired at a distance of 1.35 km from Mukul. She hears the sound after three seconds. The speed (in m/s) at which sound travels is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Distance from Mukul to the gun = 1.35 km = 1350 m.

Time taken to hear the sound = 3 s.

Speed = Distance ÷ Time = 1350 ÷ 3.

Speed = 450 m/s.

**∴ The correct answer is 450 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance of gun from Mukul = 1.35 km

Time taken by sound = 3 s

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

1 km = 1000 m

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Conversion of Units

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply the value by 5 ÷ 18. To convert m/s to km/h, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. If two equal distances are covered at speeds a and b, the average speed is (2 × a × b) ÷ (a + b).

Relative Speed

When two bodies are moving in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂. When moving in the same direction, relative speed = |S₁ − S₂|.
